verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS work-management product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out. The Asana-Disable header only toggles API behavior changes during deprecation periods, which is an unrelated control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
